name: elastic-security-mcp-app
description: Interactive blue-team security operations for Elastic Security — alert triage, attack discovery, case management, detection rules, threat hunting, and sample data generation.
long_description: An MCP App server that brings interactive blue-team security operations directly into Claude Desktop. Provides six rich React-based UIs that render inline in the conversation: alert triage with AI verdicts, AI-powered attack discovery with confidence scoring and MITRE mapping, case management with the Kibana Cases API, detection rule browsing and tuning, an ES|QL threat-hunting workbench with a D3 investigation graph, and an ECS sample-data generator for demos.

tools.name: triage-alerts

tools.name: triage-attack-discoveries
tools.description: Review AI-correlated attack chain findings with confidence scoring

tools.name: generate-attack-discovery
tools.description: Trigger on-demand attack discovery analysis via any AI connector

tools.description: Create, search, and manage SOC investigation cases

tools.name: manage-rules
tools.description: Browse, tune, and manage detection rules

tools.name: threat-hunt
tools.description: ES|QL query workbench with entity investigation graph

tools.name: generate-sample-data
tools.description: Generate ECS-compliant security events for demos

clusters_file.title: Clusters File (multi-cluster setups)
clusters_file.description: Pick a JSON file describing one or more clusters. Use this to connect to multiple clusters. If set, the inline fields below are ignored. See README for the file format.

elasticsearch_url.title: Elasticsearch URL (single-cluster setup)
elasticsearch_url.description: Elasticsearch URL (e.g. https://your-cluster.es.cloud.example.com). Leave blank if you picked a Clusters File above.

kibana_url.title: Kibana URL (single-cluster setup)
kibana_url.description: Kibana URL (e.g. https://your-cluster.kb.cloud.example.com). Leave blank if you picked a Clusters File above.

configuration_acknowledged.title: I have configured my cluster(s) above
